[spoiler=Astanir matters][b][u]The Argossians of the two lower islands[/u][/b]
While the Nordiheimian navy would save as many of the Argossians from the two lower islands as they could, both civilian and military, there would unfortunatly not be many that could be saved.
Less then 200 civilains remained when all was said and done wich would mean that it was rather easy to acomedate them on Laguz island, though the initial plan of giving them a separate area to live in was scraped as it would render them dangerously isolated, instead they were setteled close to the local Nordiheimians in such a way that they could have time for them self if they needed it but close enough that they could interact with them if that was what they wanted to.
The locals were very welcoming towards the Argossians as they had heard about what that they had gone trough, and a team of psychiatrists was sent to help them deal with and prosses the horrible trauma that they had experienced.

The remains of the Argossian militia from the islands were not in much bether shape with only about 150 personell remaining in what could be called good shape, those that was in bad shape would return to the remaining civilian population, but they could still fight and was honestly eager to do so especialy if it meant a chance for revenge or to take their homes back.
It was decided to send them to train with the Nordiheimian special forces in jungel and marine warfare as they seemed to be naturaly inclined to such fighting, pluss it would be neceseary if they were to ever take their home back anyway.
The training would also help them to focus and keep their minds buisy as to prevent them from potentialy sink into depression or dark toughts, with some help from the specialized army mental health profesionals of course.

They would also be joined by the 1000 volunteirs from mainland Astanir who would also be given marine training, ones trained they might have a force that could one day take back the two islands by their own hands, someting that would be important to build a fealing of unity among the different tribes so that their faction wouldn't fall appart if they managed to winn their freedom after the civil war.

[b][u]The Kuhaw-Astan of Mainland Astanir[/u][/b]

It had become obvious that the different aspects of a military could not be neglected in anyway when it came to the Argossians of Astanir, they needed to be put on the path of getting their own functioning military for both ground, air and sea or they would simply have any hole that existed taken advantage off and used ageinst them, as such several things needed to be done and done fast.

[u]Creating a defence towards the sea:[/u]
To strenghten their ability to defend themself ageinst naval attack Nordiheim would give them two tings;

First ting would be 10 Yawkyawk-class missile boats from Nordiheimian reserve fleet, these had good point defence from both the Tyr-1 Automatic AA module (basicly the Phalanx CIWS) and its SAM system (32 missiles with 12 km range) to handle air treaths of different types.
Its 16 anti-ship missiles with a range of 143 km (Harpoon missiles) also made it a deadly treath to any navy the Junta or Isolationists might send ageinst them and would make a good adition to their naval force.
((its basicly a slightly modefied Sa'ar 4.5 Hetz subclass missile boat))

secound ting would be for the Kuhaw-Astan land defences against naval treaths, they would be supplied a older variant of anti-ship missile systems that could be placed on trucks or Kangaroo MAMIVs for mobility, these only had a 70 km range but are both highly mobile and very easy to hide, someting that would allow them to essentialy be hiden so that they coulden't be taken out easely and provide any hostile ships that came into range with a nasty ambush suprice, especialy together with newer and better sensor and targeting systems.
They could also be provided in decent numbers in a short amount of time, wich could be important.

[u]Contesting the Air:[/u]

The Kuhaw-Astan ranks would be carefully gone trough to find any induviduals that could be used to create a airforce for the Argossian faction, be it in the form of promissing abilities or prior experience with aircraft, these would be given training from Nordiheimian merchenary pilots in how to fly the KJ-5H Cockatoo fighter jet, wich Nordiheim would provide 50 of at this point to the readied air fields.
Some these future pilots would be trained to use the AH-3 2B Argos Hornet Attack Helicopter as they could prove good for platforms of AA and ground attack missiles.

[u]Defending the ground:[/u]

A good SAM (the main ting here would be basicly Patriot systems) network would also be set up for the Argossians, with help and advice from Nordiheimian military advisors, together with point defence being properly split up and organized for the ground forces, this would provide a much needed defence for them ageinst missiles and drones incase that would apare to treathen their future plans.

In adition the the ground army would be given 100 Iron Drake 2E tanks and 50 Wombat 1 heavy APCs, wich had been upgraded with chemical warfare protection/sealing, to form the first heavy army units in the Argossian military, these they could use as armored fists to punch trough junta and isolationists lines in the south, the advisers allready there would help them with how to propperly use them.
These would come together with more Platypus 1B and AFV-5G105 Cassowary, and a lot of protective gear and heavier artilery pieces in the 155mm range, in an effort to provide them with the ability to work their way over to the Sui-mana enclave gradualy over time.

Linking their two areas together would allow better weapons and vehicles to be provided to the Sui-mana, someting they were curently lacking and wich was rather difficult to provide them.

[b][u]Meeting with the [nation]Qianxun[/nation] and the "Democrats"[/u][/b]

Having recived the message from the Sui-mana of having a propper meeting with the "Democratic" faction on the east side of Astanir Nordiheim would send a diplomatic team to part of it at the Argossians wishes.
The idea that they would bring to the table for a possible solution for the future of Astanir was a two nation solution were they each side signed a mutual defence and cooperation treaty between them in matters of military, economy and how to resolve future differences, but at the same time they would essentialy be their own nations that would be able to voice their disaproval in important matters and do their own tings within their own borders to suit the differences in culture and religeon that at this time could not trully see "eye to eye".

In a way it would be a lose union of nations to allow them to defend themself better from outside forces, be it militarily or economicaly, then they would be able to alone as tiny nations.[/spoiler]

[b]The Lower Islands[/b]
The abundance of aid given to the survivors by Nordiheim would be hugely appreciated. The trauma of such an event would be engrained in the memories of the ~200 survivors forever, but the Nordiheimians would make it more bearable. The survivors would settle in on laguz island pretty well. Their close heritage to the Nordiheimians would make the transition a lot easier.

The troops would insist that training begin straight away. There were things they could be taught by the Nordiheimians, but also things they could teach the Nordiheimians. Cooperation would be key. The 1000 volunteers would certainly help bolster numbers and provide intel into the conditions of the mainland, as well as communicate with the more lower island argossians, who have always followed a more tribal lifestyle.

The evacuation of the lower islands would allow the UDF to swiftly take the islands, giving the UDF a prime location in the argos strait.

[b]Kuhaw-Astan[/b]
The missile boats and the anti-ship missiles would be immediately integrated into Kuhaw-Astan's newly formed navy, comprised of Nordiheimian-supplied equipment, small captured restorationist ships and traditional tribal seacraft, which could be used for reconnaissance. As for defending the land, Kuhaw-Astan's entire coastline would become littered with these anti-ship missiles, attached to the back of trucks, within days. Although Kuhaw-Astan has so far recieved little naval threats, with the UDF now in control of the lower islands, they knew they had to be ready.

Not many individuals would be found with the right skillset for flying Nordiheimian aircraft. The tribespeople have had little contact with aircraft until the war, so any training given by Nordiheim would have to be comprehensive.

The provided ground defenses would mainly be built up around the southern borders of Kuhaw-Astan, as well as being airlifted into the sui-mana exclave and placed on the border with the isolationists. The restorationists were not much of a threat at this time, as they had been lying dormant in the war for quite a while at this point...

An offensive would begin to be prepared to push through into the sui-mana exclave at this point, as most isolationists forces were now concentrated in the south, in the aftermath of the democratic assault on Astan.

Ah yes, yes! Replied Villiard, We have sought out our own path towards socialism, that of the technocratic revolution, 

And what of faith? Are we to espouse radical liberalism and deny our faith? Enquired Rochambeau.

Not so! Clapped the duchess rising with grace, gentlemen, you have missed the point of our guests discussion, they bear an olive branch, a binding thread of unity, now tell me, whom has done this yet for us? The Equestrians? The Thrømm? Come now, be reasonable gentlemen, it is true that there is no hope in the modern liberal order, already we see violence and dictatorship rising in those former countries which sought classicism, she clapped her hands together, I see a bright future here in this room, if only you blind men could see it![/quote]
"I will tell you what will happen now as you continue to doubt my assertions." Lo Pilato began, his voice dropping to a quiet growl. "One day, and this day will come, these capitalist markets will suffer and there will be margin calls. There will be sell-offs as investors suddenly try to reduce their exposure in whatever toxic assets they were originally investing in, and then the people will suffer. When that happens, this liberal democratic framework that you have put your trust into will have to be reformed through unpopular laws. Then, the neo-imperialist opposition will claim that socialism has been the cause of your people's misery. Then, you will lose a vote, the neo-imperialists will take charge, and this once-in-a-lifetime economic downturn shall repeat again, but worse still, but the people will not come back to you, to the Communist Party, which has been pushed so far out of their Overton window as to be considered an unimaginable and benighted past."

Lo Pilato did not speak purely based on conjecture here. When the Tianci Uprising resulted in the deposition of the Qianxun monarchy, the revolutionaries did not install communism immediately, but instead crafted a liberal democratic model called the "Qianxun Democratic Republic" to gradually transition towards the revolution. However, repeated failures by this state to honor the needs of its own people are why it no longer exists today, instead supplanted by the totalitarian Qianxun Socialist Republic.

"I am not saying that this is a certainty that will happen tomorrow or in the weeks to come. Because only God knows what is to come. However, capitalism is inherently expoitative, which diverts the wealth of labor to those up above while leaving the worker in chains. The antithesis of capitalism is the workers' revolution. In all stages of human history, capitalism has its ups and downs, and certainly today capitalism seems to be the finest course of action for a nation, but it is not. Because for as long as it exists, exploitation exists, and so conflict exists. Eventually there will be downturns, wages will be outpaced by the costs of living, families will start to starve, and the people will be left with two choices: 1) to wallow in the nihilism of the capitalist system until their morbid death, as in the EDU, or 2) revolt and instigate the revolution. The Montfleurois are keenly aware of their own needs and how they must be met, but unless they take the next step, all these will be undone by a generation unfamiliar with the dialectic of capitalism."

On the 17th of April, 1953, a man stands impatient. The person he was waiting for was supposed to be here an hour ago, and he is getting nervous. Will this truly succeed? But he wipes doubt from his mind. The incompetence cant go on any longer, he must do this for the good of all. Finally, he hears people remark about vehicles approaching the building. Its them.

Stepping out of the central vehicle, is the man who has been causing such a fuss. King Zidan II, on his way to the central committee in order to pass yet another law, which, in the man's mind, will ruin the nation more than it has already been. Those in Elyser and Vespuria have influenced the king too much, and action must be taken.

As the king and his guards walk up the long staircase, he answers questions from reporters and onlookers the best he can while still making good time to the entrance. Now is the chance, the time to strike. Ripping the ancient pistol from its hiding place inside his coat, the man thrusts his arm outwards towards the king as he looks away, trying to answer some newsman.

He pulls the trigger. The bang is heard from inside the crowd, and people run. The bodyguards quickly huddle around the king, doing their best to identify where the shot was from. But the bullet never reached the king. The ancient pistol had exploded in the assassins hand, as the poor upkeep paired with an overloaded homemade bullet caused the weapon to malfunction catastrophically, mauling his hand and sending shrapnel into his face.

The king is ushered back to his motorcade and is secure for now. The news of such an attempt rocks the nation, and finally breaks the tension that has been building for so long. The majority of the military, under General Abu al-Sharif, would quickly mobilize and center itself around the Eastern Army Command, creating an open rebellion to the kings power, the Sabrati Revolutionary Union.

In the west, where outside influence has been much more, launched into a reactionary revolution. While groups were unorganized, they used meetings and agreements to formalize into one as the Democratic Front.

In the middle of it all, was the king and his family, the House of al-Mahdin. Using their relatively central place in all of this, those still loyal massed around the southern center of the nation to create a bulwark as well as a potential fallback route to the Lavian border.

The board is set, the game ready. [/spoiler]

[spoiler=one conflict to many?][b][u]The councils chamber in Midgard[/u][/b]

The ministers of the nordiheimian council satt around their table together with their advisors in tought and discussion about the civil war that had errupted in Sabrata not long ago.
Most of them agreed that the democratic faction should recive their support to increase their chance of potentaily finding victory in the nations civil war, as more democratic nations close to the Argos strait could only be a good ting, there was less agreement about how they should actualy support them though.

Some of the ministers, such as the ministers of war and rites together with the regional ministers of Ostland and Midland, voiced the opinion that Nordiheim should involve itself fully into the civil war with large amounts of troops on the ground supported by air to make sure that Sabrata became a fully democratic nation and new potential allie.

Opposite of them in opinion was the regional ministers of Vestland, Nordland, Sorland and Aboria, they did not want to dedicate Nordiheim so far into the civil war with how much damage the nation had suffered in the noble war that had only ended 3 years ago.
The military and economy of Nordiheim might not have the strenght at the time to survive such a undertaking with how many young men that had been lost in the last war alone, not to say anyting about the destruction that had been suffered in the Vestland region and especialy the Sorland region.

the remaining 3 ministers were not entierly sure what side they should side with, as they had each there own ideas of what could be done that did not entierly align with either of them.

At the end of the day they could not reach an agreement for what action they would take and as such it was decided that the discussion would continue tomorrow.

[b][u]The office of the Minister of war that night[/u][/b]

The minister of war, Air General Olaf Olieson, satt in his favorite wingback chair as he smoked cigar from some nation he couldn't even pretend that he know how to pronounce as he pondered how to potentialy convince more of the ministers to come around to his idea of going fully into the Sabrata civil war.
The ground army might have taken a beating in the noble war but it was also a hardened army with many veteran soldiers and commanders, why let it waste away in peace when they could use it to increase Nordiheims global power and influence?

Sitting opposite of him in another chair was Olafs trusted friend and advisor in naval matters, Admiral Omeo Thorson, who were ocasionaly taking a sip from his glass of whisky silently, a look of deep tought could be seen on his face as he was tinking about somting or the other, a look that was not uncommon for the man.

[i]Ghem for your thoughts old friend?[/i] Olaf asked Omeo, curious about what he was tinking about this time.
Omeo looked over at Olaf and asked him [i]What if we compromice with them for a much smaller force?
An elite force made of only veterans that numbers no more then ten thousand at most, with the rest of the suport for the democratic faction coming mostly in the form of our navy and military equipment that we are going to faze out anyway.[/i]

While Olaf did not look like he disliked the idea, but he did not seem to tink it would work.
[i]I don't tink that will work I'm afraid, they would need some extra reason to be given to justify any troops on the ground, even if they want the democrats to winn.[/i]

Omeo was not done though. [i]Make them two groups centered around a tank unit in each of them, one using the big Drake V and the other the new and smaller Drake VI that some of them want our military to use so badly.
The new tank came out to late to be propperly tested in the noble war and is as such untested more or less, and most people understand that a battle tested vehicle or weapon is have more reliable information behind it then one that is dependant on joust "teoretical" ability.[/i]

Olaf gave this some propper thought mulling it over in his head.
[i]That might work actualy, especialy if we also structure the units in the way some of the newer officers wants it to be done, could provide some valuable experience and information on how good their ideas actualy are, not even the more stuborn ministers can't deny that since they are part of the newer sugiestions for cost cuts in the military now that we aren't in a big war anymore.[/i]

[i]Lets put the operation under the controll of admiral Marli aswell, that woman holds a lot of respect from the Nordlandians and Olians so it would make all of it look more inviting.[/i]
Omeo added as he got up and walked over to the writhing desk in the room to start writhing it all down.

Olafs face made a slight grimace at the mention of Marlis name. [i]I don't like that woman, she is hard to deal with and refuse to follow orders that goes ageinst her principles but I can see the logic, the rest of the council would like her being in charge of it all simce they feal like they can trust her to not hide the bad tings from them.[/i]
He looks over at Omeo. [i]Writhe it all down propperly, with all the needed details, and I will present it to the other ministers tomorrow.[/i]

[b][u]The decision[/u][/b]
When the minister of war, Olaf Olieson, presented the new plan to the council the next day it sertanly got a lot more support then then his old sugestion of going all in, though some convincing still had to be done with the more reluctant ministers of how much value they could get out of this action both in a potential allie for the future and the testing of the new tank and combat doctrine that they were planing to use for potential future conflicts.
It was eventualy desided that the majority was in favor of this plan since there was not realy any better one presented, 10'000 soldiers formed into essentialy two army regiments containing 2 tank battalions, 1 armored infantry battalion and 3 mobile infantry battalions each, were one regiment would use the heavy tank Drake V and the other the brand new medium tank Drake VI, both to make use of the many Drake Vs they had and to see if the Drake VI was actualy any good in live combat and worth furter investments.
In addition the weapons, equipment and amunitions they would supply to the democratic faction would mostly be those that they had allready planed to either stop using or faze out of active service in the next 5-10 years to streamline their logistics and cut costs, pluss a bunch of material captured in the noble war wich was now joust laying in storage buildings collecting dust.

Naturaly admiral Marli Aegiraett would be in overall comand of this undertaking as a prerequisite for accepting Olafs suggested plan, joust as Omeo had predicted it would be, her ability to understand military matters outside of joust the navy combined with the Nordiheimian peoples trust in her would be important to get their approval for this undertaking.
Admiral Marli herself wasn't to happy to hear about this course of action though, in her opinion you either stayed out of things like this or went all in, this somewhat half hearthed act could end badly if not done carefully wich unfortunatly meant that she was one of the best people to oversee it, as such she would accept the asignment atleast so that it was done as propperly as it could be.

A delegation would have to be sendt to the Democratic front first though to establish contact and get their agreement for their entry into their civil war, it would be rather difficult to support them if they didn't want them there and started shooting at them.
The moment they would get their blessing they would send the 2nd and 3rd Argossian Navy groups, each containing 2 Skoll-class battleships and 1 Hati-class carrier, to provide sea support and start the landing of both military material and the "special expedition force" as they had ended up naming them.

The council did not tink that they would need to wait for to long for an answer from the Democratic front.[/spoiler]
